Assign an L1 regularization penalty factor (LLM-Lasso protocol) to each supplied baseline measurement using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
{"task": "Assess the likelihood of structural thyroid enlargement or a thyroid mass prompting further evaluation.", "fields": {"F2": {"description": "sick at presentation", "name": "sick"}, "F3": {"description": "pregnancy status", "name": "pregnant"}, "F5": {"description": "tumour indicator", "name": "tumor"}, "F10": {"description": "total thyroxine", "name": "TT4"}, "F1": {"description": "recorded sex", "name": "sex"}, "F9": {"description": "triiodothyronine", "name": "T3"}, "F12": {"description": "free thyroxine index", "name": "FTI"}, "F0": {"description": "age in years", "name": "age"}, "F6": {"description": "hypopituitary status", "name": "hypopituitary"}, "F13": {"description": "thyroxine binding globulin", "name": "TBG"}, "F4": {"description": "presence of goitre", "name": "goitre"}, "F8": {"description": "thyroid stimulating hormone", "name": "TSH"}, "F7": {"description": "psychiatric indicator", "name": "psych"}, "F11": {"description": "thyroxine uptake", "name": "T4U"}}}
